# Purv Taparia — Personal Portfolio

> Purv Taparia is a student in Grade 5 at Chatrabhuj Narsee School, Mumbai, India. He is a 5× published author, two-time International Rank 1 English Olympiad winner, coder, newsletter blogger, Arduino-certified maker, and national-level roller skating competitor.

## About

Purv Taparia (born ~2016, Mumbai, India) is a prodigious student with achievements spanning academic Olympiads, creative writing, hardware engineering, and software development. He studies at Chatrabhuj Narsee School (cns.ac.in), Mumbai.

**Roles:** Student · Published Author · Developer · Newsletter Blogger · Roller Skater

**Location:** Mumbai, India

## Projects

- **Neo-Pixel Game** — 8×8 NeoPixel grid game (Arduino, C++) [Jan 2026] — https://github.com/tapariapurv/neopixel-game
- **Air Quality Monitor** — Arduino-based AQM built during the Delhi smog crisis (Arduino, C++, sensors) [Nov 2025] — https://youtube.com/shorts/qGbcmELwwhQ
- **Radar System** — Arduino UNO radar with signal processing and real-time detection [May 2026] — https://youtube.com/shorts/xNrgtW_awv8
- **Rapid Games** — Free online gaming platform built with Ridit and Devansh (HTML/CSS/JS, GitHub Pages) [Oct 2025] — https://tapariapurv.github.io/rapidgames
- **LiteWarden** — Chrome extension for local password management (JavaScript, Chrome APIs) [Jan 2026, in progress] — https://github.com/tapariapurv/chrome-extension
- **Antigravity Usage Monitor** — Analytics dashboard for Google Antigravity (Next.js, TypeScript, SQLite) [Jun 2026] — https://github.com/tapariapurv/antigravity-usage-monitor
- **Logek** — Adaptive vocabulary learning app with spaced repetition and gamification (React, TypeScript, Firebase) [Aug 2026] — https://tapariapurv.github.io/Logek
- **Market Alert Matrix** — ESP8266 + 16-LED NeoPixel ring device in a 3D-printed case that shows the market's live move from the previous close (one LED per 0.2%) and sounds a piezo alarm past 1% (ESP8266, C++, NeoPixels, APIs) [Aug 2026]
- **Velvet Pour** — GSAP-animated cocktail brand landing page (React, GSAP, Tailwind CSS) [Aug 2026] — https://cocktail-site-lac.vercel.app/
- **Indian Stock Data Hub** — Open-source research desk for Indian listed companies with local AI analysis and Excel/Word reports (Python, Streamlit, Ollama) [Sep 2026] — https://github.com/tapariapurv/indian-stock-data-hub
